title: /config: the Skills page, the Delegate skill per job, and the TypeSafe page
description:
Per the map tickets 'Prototype: the /config modal' (harness-0sx.9, SKILLS, DELEGATE SKILLS, TYPESAFE) and 'Third-party skills' (harness-0sx.7, the /config pick list); prototype as in Ticket 9.

Skills page: the installed skills with source @ commit and the jobs using each. a adds from a pasted source (a bare name refused; a repo with several skills shows a checklist, the installed ones ticked); u updates, U updates all; d removes, after asking (a skill a job uses sets that job to none; Shipped skills cannot be removed); a clone in progress shows in the foot. The location read-only, with 'Run harness init again to change where skills are installed.'

Delegate skills: each Stage page lists its jobs with their picks (Implement: test-first, self review, working mode, prose; Review: review; Debate: over-engineering audit; Address: merge conflicts). A job's pick list: its suggestions (Ticket 17), each marked installed, yours (user level or a plugin) or not installed; none; then every other skill you have under a divider; type to filter. Picking one you have uses it as it is (no install, not updatable from /config); picking a not-installed one installs it, then picks it. A job lists only skills its Stage's App can see (codex: .agents/skills and its built-ins).

TypeSafe page: on or off, with the key. Turning it off asks first and says what changes (every Wake and Plan becomes a Question; disputed Findings are skipped and listed in the PR); on without a key asks the key, masked. Every change saves at once.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Screen tests over fake Tools: adding owner/repo with two skills shows the checklist and installs the ticked one; a bare name is refused; removing a skill a job uses sets it to none after the confirmation; picking a not-installed suggestion clones and picks it; the Review job on codex hides a claude-only personal skill; TypeSafe off asks, then saves off; on asks a masked key. TestBackend renders of the Skills page and a job's pick list.
